title: AUDITOR — Army National Guard Units
summary: THIS IS A NATIONAL GUARD TITLE 5 EXCEPTED SERVICE POSITION. This National Guard position is for a AUDITOR. Position is located in the United States Property and Fiscal Office. Serves as an agent of the United States Property and Fiscal Officer (USPFO) on accounting, financial, and managerial issues that require examination by a financial professional. $106,437–$138,370 per year

title: Park Manager (Superintendent) — National Park Service
summary: This position serves as the Superintendent of three National Park Service units, duty-stationed at Christiansted National Historic Site in St. Croix, U.S. Virgin Islands. Cost of Living Allowance (COLA) rate of 11.88% is authorized for this location. This position is also open to public under announcement CAHT-27-13093224-DE-MH.
